content_sections.heading: POWERGRID Apprentice Vacancy 2026 – Region & State-Wise Details
content_sections.text: Candidates should apply to only one region/state of their choice. The table below gives the total posts notified for each region and the states it covers. State-wise breakup within each region: All-India trade-wise total (computed by adding the trade-wise figures across all 10 regions): Detailed category-wise (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/UR/PwBD) breakup for each state and trade, along with PwBD sub-category eligibility, is provided in the respective region's official notification PDF (linked in the Important Links section below). Note that Southern Region-I does not notify any post under the Graduate (Civil) trade. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD is applicable across all regions as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules, 1992 (amended by the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Rules, 2025), amended from time to time. The number of training slots in every region is provisional/tentative and may vary as per the actual requirement of the company and reservation compliance at the time of engagement.

content_sections.heading: POWERGRID Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is uniform across all 10 regions and is assessed as on the closing date of application (10.09.2026). Candidates must possess the qualification prescribed for the trade and must have passed their final examination within two years from the closing date of application (i.e., between 11.09.2024 and 10.09.2026) Candidates must be medically fit as per the provisions of the Apprentices Act, 1961 Candidates must hold a full-time regular degree/diploma/ITI qualification from a recognized institute/university; part-time, correspondence, distance, or online mode qualifications are not accepted The date of declaration of result must be mentioned in the marksheet; if not, a supporting certificate from the college/university is required The percentage of marks in the final examination must be mentioned in the final/consolidated marksheet, or a Percentage Conversion Letter must be submitted The required area of specialization must be mentioned in the certificate, or a supporting letter from the institute is required Candidates are NOT eligible to apply if they: Are awaiting the results of their final examination Have not completed 18 years of age Have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training in any organization, for any duration Have more than 1 year of job experience

rows.required_qualification: B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. (Engg.) in Civil Engineering (full-time, 4-year course) - not notified in SR-I

content_sections.heading: POWERGRID Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age: Candidates must have completed 18 years of age at the time of application, across all regions Applicants must be Indian citizens and at least 18 years old at the time of application No maximum age limit or age relaxation details are specified in any of the 10 regional notifications Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: POWERGRID Apprentice Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The monthly stipend structure is uniform across all 10 regions, subject to satisfactory performance and attendance. An additional ₹2,500 per month is payable if company accommodation is not provided or availed The DBT portion is provided by the Government of India under the NATS scheme, subject to an active Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account Apprentices are entitled to 12 days of Casual Leave (pro-rata) and 15 days of Medical Leave for the one-year duration, across all regions

content_sections.heading: POWERGRID Apprentice Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026 in any of the 10 regions. None of the notifications require a written examination or interview.

content_sections.heading: POWERGRID Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are screened in merit order based on eligibility criteria and the qualification prescribed for each trade, region-wise Incomplete or ineligible applications are summarily rejected without intimation Reservation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD is applied as per the Apprentices Act, 1961 Candidates are called for document verification in a ratio of 1:5 against the notified training slots, in merit order Shortlisted candidates are informed through their registered email; no TA/DA is paid for attending document verification A final merit list is prepared from candidates found suitable after document verification Selected candidates must accept a tripartite apprenticeship contract on the NATS/NAPS portal and submit a medical certificate and police verification before engagement For PwBD candidates in Western Region-II, reservation/relaxation is subject to submission of a medical certificate for permanent disability, and only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the PwBD benefit

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment
content_sections.text: Apprenticeship registration/enrolment number under NAPS/NATS with 100% completed profile Scanned educational certificates and marksheets Proof of age (Matriculation Certificate, Aadhaar Card, Passport, etc.) SC/ST/latest OBC(NCL) caste certificate, if applicable Bank cancelled cheque or first page of passbook (DBT-enabled account) Recent colour passport-size photograph and signature Disability certificate/UDID card in the prescribed format, if applicable (Unique Disability ID required for Western Region-I)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register as a candidate/student on NAPS (for ITI-Electrician) at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in, or on NATS (for Degree/Diploma in Engineering/Civil) at nats.education.gov.in, and complete/update the profile with all required documents After obtaining the NAPS/NATS registration/enrolment number, visit www.powergrid.in Go to Careers → Engagement of Apprentices → Apply Online Select the region/state you wish to apply for (only one region/state is allowed) Fill in the online application with the required details and upload documents Submit the application before the last date, 10.09.2026 Applications must be submitted online through the official POWERGRID website only; no other mode of application is accepted, in any region.

content_sections.heading: POWERGRID Apprentice Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates should apply for only one region/state of their choice, out of all 10 regions Candidates submitting multiple applications, or applying for more than one region/state/trade, will not be considered and their applications will be summarily rejected The Name and Date of Birth on the application must match the Matriculation Certificate, Aadhaar Card, and bank account records Candidates found ineligible, or providing false information, may be disqualified at any stage of the engagement process or during the engagement period Completion of the apprenticeship does not entitle the apprentice to any claim for employment with POWERGRID Training location will be decided as per facility availability and may be changed during the apprenticeship, including for job rotation, within the notified state Shared bachelor accommodation may be provided subject to availability Apprentices must maintain a weekly work diary and adhere to POWERGRID's code of conduct POWERGRID reserves the right to terminate the apprenticeship for absenteeism, indiscipline, misconduct, poor performance, or policy violation

content_sections.heading: POWERGRID Apprentice Important Links (Region-Wise)
content_sections.text: Candidates who have completed their Diploma or Graduate degree in Electrical/Civil Engineering can also explore more Diploma Government Jobs and Engineering Government Jobs available across India. Candidates looking for more apprenticeship opportunities can also check the latest Maharashtra Government Jobs , Uttar Pradesh Government Jobs , and West Bengal Government Jobs across various departments. Applicants searching for openings in the Northeast can check Assam Government Jobs and North East Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. Those holding an ITI certificate in Electrician trade can also browse more ITI Government Jobs and PSU Apprentice Jobs matching their qualification.

faq.question: Q1. What is POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an engagement of apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, by Power Grid Corporation of India Limited, notified separately for 10 regional establishments covering states across India.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are there in POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 270 posts across all 10 regions, computed by adding the region-wise totals from each notification.

faq.question: Q3. Which region has the highest number of posts?
faq.answer: Western Region-II (Vadodara), covering Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat, has the highest count at 38 posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 10.09.2026 across all regions. The window opened on 25.08.2026.

faq.question: Q5. Can I apply for more than one region?
faq.answer: No. Candidates should apply for only one region/state of their choice; multiple applications across regions, states, or trades will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for POWERGRID Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: It depends on the trade: ITI in Electrician for ITI-Electrician, Diploma in Civil/Electrical Engineering for Diploma posts, and B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc.(Engg.) in Civil or Electrical Engineering for Graduate posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed 18 years of age at the time of application. No maximum age limit is specified in any regional notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: There is no application fee in any of the 10 regions.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply online for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register on NAPS or NATS as applicable, then apply through www.powergrid.in under Careers → Engagement of Apprentices → Apply Online, selecting your chosen region.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for POWERGRID Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is merit-based on qualifying marks, followed by document verification (called in a 1:5 ratio to notified slots) and a final merit list - there is no written exam or interview.
